Generate JAGS Model Files for Bayesian Meta-Analysis

Source: R/jags_models.R
jags_model_file.Rd

Writes a JAGS model file for common meta-analysis models (binary, continuous, count outcomes) with a user-specified prior on the between-study standard deviation (sigma). These model files can be passed directly to R2jags::jags().

Usage

jags_model_file(
  outcome = c("bin", "ctns", "count"),
  model,
  type = c("ran", "fix"),
  sigma_prior = jags_prior_halfnormal(0.5),
  path = NULL
)

jags_prior_halfnormal(scale = 0.5)

jags_prior_halfcauchy(scale = 0.5)

jags_prior_uniform(upper = 5)

Arguments

outcome

Character: "bin", "ctns", or "count".

model

Character: model specification string.

  • Binary: "std.norm", "std.dt", "reg.norm", "reg.dt"

  • Continuous: "std.ta", "std.mv", "reg.ta", "reg.mv"

  • Count: "std", "std.unif", "std.hc", "reg", "reg.unif", "reg.hc"

type

Character: "fix" (common-effects) or "ran" (random-effects).

sigma_prior

Character: a block of JAGS code defining sigma and tau. Must define both variables. Defaults to a half-normal(0, 0.5) prior. Use the helper functions:

  • jags_prior_halfnormal(scale) (default)

  • jags_prior_halfcauchy(scale)

  • jags_prior_uniform(upper)

path

File path to write the model to. Defaults to a tempfile.

scale

Scale parameter of the half-Cauchy. Default 0.5.

upper

Upper bound of the uniform. Default 5.

Value

The file path (invisibly), for passing to R2jags::jags().

Functions

  • jags_prior_halfnormal(): Half-normal prior on sigma: sigma ~ N(0, scale^2) T(0,)

  • jags_prior_halfcauchy(): Half-Cauchy prior on sigma via the scale-mixture representation.

  • jags_prior_uniform(): Uniform prior on sigma.
